An active user is typically defined as a user who has had at least one session during the week (i.e., their session count is greater than 0). 

We can count the number of active users by iterating through the list of session counts and counting how many elements are strictly greater than zero.

### Confidence Level: 100%

```python
def count_active(sessions):
    """
    Returns the number of active users (users with at least one session).
    """
    return sum(1 for count in sessions if count > 0)
```
